limits.en: 1 TB of query processing per month and 10 GB of active storage per month at no charge (Google Cloud free tier).

keyLimits.en: Approximately $6.25 per TB of data queried (US multi-region), first 1 TB/month free; active storage ~$0.02/GB/month, long-term storage (no edits for 90 days) ~$0.01/GB/month.
Committed or on-demand slot pricing (compute capacity), billed per slot-hour rather than per byte scanned; used for predictable, high-volume workloads.

cautions.en: On-demand pricing is billed per TB of data scanned by a query, not a flat monthly fee; costs scale directly with query volume and table design (partitioning/clustering affects cost significantly).
Storage and compute (query) costs are billed separately and both apply even on the free tier once thresholds are exceeded.

capabilities.en: Serverless, fully-managed enterprise data warehouse for running SQL analytics at petabyte scale without managing infrastructure.
Built-in machine learning via BigQuery ML, allowing models to be trained and run using SQL directly on stored data.
Native integration with the Google Cloud ecosystem (Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow) plus third-party BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and ETL platforms (Airflow, dbt).

limitations.en: Cost can be unpredictable for ad hoc or poorly optimized queries under the on-demand model, since price scales with bytes scanned.
Requires SQL and data-modeling expertise (partitioning, clustering) to control cost and performance; not a point-and-click tool.

reason.en: BI/analytics layer often paired with or compared to BigQuery for querying and visualizing data.
Alternative analytics platform for product/event data that competes for some of the same analytics workloads.
